description.value: Feast & Fallow is a fully plant-based/vegan café in Vancouver's Cambie corridor, serving locally sourced coffee, house-baked pastries and breads, savoury toasts, and a Saturday brunch menu. The café operates with a volunteer crew and is deeply mission-driven, advocating for a just urban food system through community workshops on topics like urban agriculture, composting, and food security. A touring cyclist stopping here will find a welcoming, community-minded space with a full espresso bar and substantial vegan food options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and corroborates OSM data: same address (305 W. 41st Ave), phone (6047233433), and email. OSM tag diet:vegan=only is strongly confirmed by the website's self-description as a 'plant-based/vegan cafe' and an entirely plant-based menu. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those remain null. One concern: OSM lists hours as Tu-Sa 08:00-15:00, but the website states Mon-Fri 8am-4pm and Sat 8am-3pm — a discrepancy flagged below.
concerns: Hours discrepancy: OSM lists Tu-Sa 08:00-15:00, but the website states Mon-Fri 8am-4pm and Sat 8am-3pm — OSM appears to be missing Monday and has an earlier weekday closing time. Website value is likely more current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible vegan café with a confirmed website and matching contact details. Offers food and coffee relevant to touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website self-describes as 'plant-based/vegan cafe'; entire menu uses plant-based ingredients only (Violife, Daiya, Just Egg, tofu bacon, oat milk as default)
